questions: How many Josephson junctions did you fabricate and measure, and how many showed SQUID-like patterns? The text says "multiple devices" (p. 2) and "three independent devices" (p. 8); if three were measured and three showed it, saying so would settle this.
If any junctions were set aside, why?
Which field ranges and field angles did you measure beyond those shown in Figs. 4 and 5, and did you measure the in-plane orientation (By) on Dev 1 and Dev 2 as well?
What does the second-best junction look like, and did any junction show a Fraunhofer-like pattern?

Without a gate, how do you tell topological facet states from accumulation layers at the ion-milled flake edges? A junction made the same way on a trivial reference crystal, or a gated device that depletes the bulk, would separate the two.

In Fig. 5c the two partly merged channels lie along the thickness, which places them near the top and bottom a–c faces that you expect to be gapped. Could the substrate interface and the Pd contact interface carry them?

For Fig. 3d, how does the diffusive long-junction form fit over the full temperature range, and what junction lengths, δE values and mean free path (Supplementary Note 2) go into the comparison, given that your SdH data show a bulk electron pocket?
The text gives the STM edge-state width as "≈ 6 µm" (p. 5), with a 5 nm scale bar in Fig. 2g, and then calls the 0.7-1.5 µm Js half-widths "substantially larger" (p. 7). Which value is intended?
